normalization_notes: The upstream dataset currently contains a non-canonical extra record; application reference output is explicitly limited to atomic numbers 1..118.
Wikipedia summary prose is intentionally excluded.
Only structured element facts, source-page links and media metadata are retained.
Reference values are not application-published M02 claims until they pass the existing field publication policy.
Density units follow the upstream README convention: gases g/L; solids and liquids g/cm^3.
Melting and boiling points are Kelvin; molar heat is J/(mol*K).
The source dataset represents ionization energies and electron affinity in kJ/mol.
Media binaries are not copied into this repository; only source URLs and attribution metadata are stored.
